examples.sentence: Laws, regulations and policies relating to environmental, social, and governance are expanding globally.
Stakeholders, including our investors and our employees, have increasingly focused on, and are expected to continue to focus on, our ESG practices.
We cannot guarantee that we will achieve our announced environmental, social and governance goals and initiatives.
The COVID-19 pandemic accelerated these changes and also resulted in higher network utilization, as more customers consumed bandwidth from changes in work and learn from home trends.

For example, in 2020, the COVID-19 pandemic and resulting policies, initiatives and impacts, along with the related global slowdown in economic activity, resulted in our decreased revenues, increased costs and lower earnings per share.
